Package com.epitech.depthdiablo.item

Class Consumable

java.lang.Object
com.epitech.depthdiablo.item.Item
com.epitech.depthdiablo.item.Consumable
Direct Known Subclasses:
Potion
public abstract class Consumable extends Item
An item used once from the hotbar, such as a potion (GDD 1.3.1, 1.4).

Pattern: Command. Each consumable is one action the player triggers.

  • Constructor Details

    • Consumable

      protected Consumable(String id, String nameKey, String spriteId, int price)
      Creates a consumable. Every consumable has the Rarity.CONSUMABLE rarity, so loot tables can pick consumables by that tier.
      Parameters:
      id - the item's key in the data files
      nameKey - the translation key of its name
      spriteId - the picture the renderer draws for it
      price - its shop price in coins; 0 means free
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if a text is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if a text is blank or the price is negative

  • Method Details

    • use

      public abstract boolean use(Character user)
      Applies this consumable's effect. The user is who used it, not always who it affects.
      Parameters:
      user - the character who uses it
      Returns:
      true if the consumable was spent and its hotbar slot must be emptied; false if nothing happened and the player keeps it
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if user is null
